integrity: The infinite proof is self-contained after standard finite-field subfield and cyclic-group facts: the explicit three-flat is the subfield \(\mathbb F_8\), and the relevant exponent reduces to \(5\) modulo \(7\). The same witness independently satisfies the motivating paper’s obstruction polynomial. No computational search is used to establish the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only odd dimensions divisible by 3 and does not settle the remaining dimensions of the Welch third-order sum-freedom conjecture. The exact verifier is a bounded regression check, not evidence for the infinite quantifier. A later revision of the motivating preprint is catalogued on 2026-09-28 but was not materially available for full-text comparison, leaving a stated bibliographic risk.
title: A canonical \(\mathbb F_8\) witness for Welch functions when \(n\equiv3\pmod 6\)
